_comment: Suites excluded from `yarn test:ci` (WP-A8). Every entry failed on the Track A baseline of 2026-09-23, before any Track A change touched it.
Remove an entry when its suite is fixed; add one only with a reason and an issue link. `yarn test` still runs everything.
This ledger is for suites that are broken. Suites that need live infrastructure are not broken and do not belong here - they are listed in test/integrationSuites.js and excluded by jest.config.ts.
A suite can be both: seed_apex needs live Mongo and Postgres AND is currently broken, so it appears in both places.

suites.reason: Broken as well as integration, so it is listed here and in test/integrationSuites.js. It cannot pass against an empty database: it inserts ReactoryClassroomClass through the raw repository without a clientKey, and the entity declares that column NOT NULL (@ClientKeyColumn defaults to nullable: false) - the value normally comes from the tenant repository wrapper, which this path bypasses. It only appears to pass where the 10A-10F rows it seeds already exist, because its findOne guard then skips the insert. Fix the insert (or use the tenant repository), then remove this entry.
